purpose: Recover the Phase69 evaluator-integrity failure by preserving native RINEX system recognition for SBAS/NavIC rows while retaining physical-record framing and the Phase68 taxonomy.

input_pin_source.raw_and_base_pins: Phase69 freeze exact raw CSV and base RINEX pins

source_system_contract.signal_policy: S and I are recognized source systems; if the pinned signal policy has no finite selected code signal for a row, consume its physical record and skip it from selected matching streams. Do not invent a signal or classify it as malformed.

recovery_contract.long_record_rule: If a satellite record first line exceeds 80 columns, consume that line only.
recovery_contract.standard_record_rule: If the first line is at most 80 columns, consume exactly ceil(observation_type_count/5) lines and reject a premature epoch marker or satellite line.
recovery_contract.epoch_marker: RINEX3 epoch lines begin with '>' and are never satellite records.
recovery_contract.proxy_disclaimer: source-filtered raw adopted and base selected counts are diagnostic proxies and are not asserted equal to native adopted FGO factor populations

decision_policy: This recovery only repairs evaluator framing/system recognition. It does not authorize native correction, canonicalization, interpolation, solver execution, accuracy-truth reads, or reuse of Phase68/Phase69 partial outputs. Any malformed record, hash mismatch, parser ambiguity, or read-contract violation fails closed.
